title: Something from nothing
objective: Enter a non-empty string made entirely from Unicode format characters (Cf).

inputs.label: Text
inputs.description: Invisible input is represented by labeled tokens.

graphDescription: The graph counts real scalars and checks their Unicode general category.
hints: Search for ZERO WIDTH SPACE or WORD JOINER in the character lab.
explanation: A string can contain real data without an ordinary visible glyph. Format controls can affect layout, joining, ordering, or parsing even when the rendered line appears empty.
